status_notes: Agreement buckets use the two saved blind reports only. Reconciliation is counted separately and never replaces a blind report. Each criterion takes the strongest status among that report's findings. A criterion can occur in multiple categories; category counts deduplicate within task and category. Missing reports are unavailable, never zero findings. Counts describe AI reviewer judgments, not human-verified errors or corrected benchmark scores.
